title: Prehistory & The Origin
subtitle: The first entities, lost civilizations, and the Wheel of Time

cards.title: Cycles of Time
cards.text: Time in Wraeclast is not linear — it is circular. Navali calls it "The Future — The Past": Hinekora doesn't see the future, only the past and what will repeat. Each cycle ends in catastrophe, and everything begins anew.
cards.flavorText: "If Time truly is a circle, aren't we all condemned to repeat our lives forever?" — Gwennen

cards.title: Kalandra and the Mysterious Lake
cards.text: Kalandra — the most ancient entity, predating the gods themselves. When she arrived at Wraeclast, there was only the Lake — molten land and primordial ooze. "Curiosity is my undoing" — she became trapped in the Lake, unable to leave. She calls herself "The Observer" — watching life evolve over millions of years.
cards.quote: "I looked away for just a moment, and the little creatures had invented religion. What are gods, if not thieves of virtue?" — Kalandra, Ancient Etchings IV
cards.flavorText: "What you need, little thief, is a broken mirror." — Kalandra, Ancient Etchings V

cards.title: Precursors — The First Civilization
cards.text: Before even the Vaal, Precursors ruled Wraeclast — a civilization so ancient that geology itself has erased its traces. They built tower systems capable of reshaping terrain and ecosystems across all Wraeclast. Doryani notes: "They too delved into the secrets of the world. Corruption was but one of many energies they mastered."
cards.flavorText: "They were masters of their world. They built constructions whose mere ruins inspire awe... even in me." — Doryani

cards.title: The Three Edicts of Mothersoul
cards.text: Precursors left pictographs in their ruins — safeguard instructions for future civilizations. Doryani discovered three murals: First Edict (destroyed), Second (Seed of Corruption), Third (The Weapon to destroy the Seed and The Beast). The Weapon was never completed — the Precursors were "interrupted."
cards.warning: Fourth Edict: "Humanity has failed... Must begin anew. By the Sacred Fire of Mothersoul, Her flesh shall be burned." — Arbiter of Ash
cards.flavorText: "Her earth has been soiled once more... By the Fourth Edict... Her flesh shall be burned." — Arbiter of Ash

cards.title: Cosmic Entities
cards.text: Beyond gods, there exist Cosmic Entities that transcend all divinity. Chaos observes multiple timelines, manipulating fate through randomness. The Maven — an alien entity that "collects" battles for entertainment. The Elder — entity from the Void.
cards.flavorText: "I do not destroy. I merely... observe." — Chaos
